comps.label: C1
comps.reason: Shares Alaska telecom, internet and cable, but its core is electric power generation and utility sales, a different business.

comps.label: C2
comps.reason: Same mix of wireless, broadband, enterprise and government connectivity over its own networks, sold via own stores and direct sales.

comps.label: C3
comps.reason: Contracted construction and maintenance labor for carriers and utilities, not selling connectivity services to consumers, businesses or government.

comps.label: C4
comps.reason: Sells broadband, voice and video to households and businesses over its own network, though without wireless or Alaska exposure.

comps.label: C5
comps.reason: Same wireless plus wireline broadband, business connectivity and managed IT model, serving consumers, businesses and government with own stores.

comps.label: C6
comps.reason: Core business is leasing wholesale fiber and copper capacity to carriers under long-term contracts; retail broadband is secondary.

comps.label: C7
comps.reason: Satellite broadband, aviation and maritime connectivity, and defense electronics manufacturing, not terrestrial telecom service to Alaska households and businesses.
